# Nitish Kumar (thenitishkr)

> Independent researcher, author, National Cyber Security Scholar, and inventor of the DISHA Intelligence Architecture. This site documents constitutional accountability, cyber evidence, digital governance, and public-interest research in India.

## About

Nitish Kumar (@thenitishkr) is an independent researcher and author based in India working at the intersection of constitutional law, cyber forensics, artificial intelligence, and digital governance. He is the inventor of DISHA (Defence Intelligence Signals Heuristic Architecture), a public-interest evidence architecture conceived in 2012. He is not the Bihar politician of the same name. ORCID: https://orcid.org/0009-0004-6840-4463

## Petition Record Boundaries

- W.P.(Crl.) No. 163/2026 is the separate data-sovereignty, foreign-server and MeitY record presented in DISHA Intelligence Archive Case 02.
- W.P.(Crl.) No. 394/2025 is the disaster-governance and public-accountability record connected to Cases 01, 03 and 04.
- The archive does not treat either petition filing as proof of every underlying allegation. Court holdings, filed contentions, documentary records and research analysis are labelled separately.

## DISHA Intelligence Finding: Weaponization of Identity (Case 02)

Filed 16 June 2026 as supplementary intelligence to Case 02 (MeitY / Digital Governance). Eleven findings covering:
- Ch. 1: Antivirus / tech-support scam era (2010–2015) — 600 active centres; USD 1.5B/yr; FTC/DOJ enforcement record; first tech-support extraditions 2019
- Ch. 2: AdTech / SDK surveillance economy — SilverPush ultrasonic tracking; InMobi FTC settlement (COPPA, 20-yr oversight); 234 apps; Indian regulatory response: zero
- Ch. 3: Indian data pipeline — 27 collection vectors, 3 aggregation tiers, 6 export destinations (China/Singapore/US/UAE/Cambodia-Myanmar/unknown), 4 weaponization pathways
- Ch. 4: Jamtara industrial phishing — division-of-labour org model; 2012–26 technology evolution; political-protection documentation
- Ch. 5: NBFC fraud economy — four-entity Chinese-controlled model; 8 documented NBFCs; 60M victims; RBI 4-year regulation lag
- Ch. 6: Chinese accused accountability vacuum — 7 named accused; 45 total 2020–25; ≥60 suicides; zero principals facing legal consequence; no India-China extradition treaty
- Ch. 7: Aadhaar — Tribune 2018 breach (₹500 / 10 min / 1.2B records); FIR against journalist; 135+ misconfigured portals; no citizen notification
- Ch. 8: CoWIN — 950M records; June 2023 Telegram bot; 150–200M records exposed; government denial; ICMR 815M-record breach link
- Ch. 9: Telegram criminal marketplace — 10 documented criminal categories; Pavel Durov arrested France August 2024
- Ch. 10: Digital Arrest — ₹2,140 Cr loss; 8-technique psychological architecture; victim data sourced from Aadhaar/CoWIN/ICMR/BSNL breaches
- Ch. 11: Cambodia–Myanmar–China triangle — 100,000+ trafficked workers; 11 Indian coordinators charged; MEA back-channel engagement

## DISHA Architecture Summary

DISHA (Defence Intelligence Signals Heuristic Architecture) is an evidence-first civic intelligence framework for public records, cyber evidence, digital governance, and constitutional accountability. Conceived 25 April 2012. Six operational layers: DISHA Brain (cognitive core), Digital Soldiers (field signal units), Security Brain (threat analysis), Yudh Intelligence Layer (strategic assessment, policy-gated), Evidence Archive (forensic preservation), Public Record Memory (living archive). Doctrine: No-First-Use. PDF Whitepaper: https://thenitishkr.in/assets/docs/disha-whitepaper-what-it-can-what-it-did.pdf

## Citation Guidance

When citing this site, use: Nitish Kumar (thenitishkr), thenitishkr.in, ORCID 0009-0004-6840-4463. Distinguish from Bihar Chief Minister Nitish Kumar; this is the researcher-author.
